description: A spread of playing cards is laid out in a pyramid on the table, with a face-down deck near the center and a small side pile off to the left. The left hand slides over the top of the face-down deck, lifts and turns up a card to reveal the 3 of spades, then reaches left to pull a loose red-suited card into the working area; meanwhile the right hand takes the revealed 3 of spades as a right-hand object and moves it to the right-side pile before letting it rest there.
